C1365.title: Poly Network Cross-Chain Bridge Attack
C1365.summary: In August 2021, the cross-chain interoperability protocol Poly Network was exploited by an attacker who leveraged a contract vulnerability allowing the replacement of relay chain validator public keys. Through hash collision, the attacker invoked a method to modify the public key, gained control of validators, and signed malicious transactions, stealing approximately $610 million in crypto assets
